title: Zubiri: Mark Villar’s move to majority not connected to impeachment trial
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Mark Villar’s move to the Senate majority bloc has nothing to do with the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel “Migz” Zubiri…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Mark Villar’s move to the Senate majority bloc has nothing to do with the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel “Migz” Zubiri said Thursday. Zubiri’s remarks came after the Senate elected Villar as chairperson of the Committee on Public Works and as a member of the Commission on Appointments (CA). These moves effectively welcomed him back to the majority bloc. “But, you know, we had a heart-to-heart discussion with Senator Mark,” the majority leader also admitted.
